name: Bardo
install: cd /agent/repos/bardo && npm ci && npm run build

terminals.name: server
terminals.description: Bardo proxy + production UI server on http://localhost:8080 (serves Sherpa/Scramjet runtime assets, wisp WebSocket, and the Klystron/Opulent server-side engines). Requires `npm run build` to have produced dist/ first (done in install).

terminals.name: vite
terminals.description: Vite UI dev server with HMR on http://localhost:5173, proxying /api, /wisp and the proxy-runtime paths to the server terminal on port 8080. Use this for interface development.
